# AgentSIM

> SIM-secured P-256 spending authority for a personal NEAR AI agent. Recorded run: physical SIM over PC/SC. Local NEAR sandbox, test funds.

## Start

- [Judge brief](submission/judge-brief.json): commands, expected output, evidence paths
- [README](README.md): product and 60-second check
- [Verification](docs/VERIFICATION.md): claim, mechanism, limits, emulator control

## Verify

- `npm test` → `# pass 48`
- `node tests/near-sandbox/verify-restricted.mjs evidence/near/2026-11-15-live-near-ai.json` → `Verified restricted key setup, …`
- Applet suite (JDK 17+): `npm run card-sim:setup` then `npm run card-sim:test` → `# pass 21`

## Limits

Local sandbox, no public-chain settlement, no compute delivery, no device attestation, no shipped phone app.
